machine: Apple M5, 16 GB (the client's M1 Air will be slower; not measured)
environment: Python 3.13 venv at ~/vision3d-triposr; torch 2.15 with MPS; transformers 4.57.6 (5.x renamed ViT layers and cannot load the weights); torchmcubes compiled locally (needs scikit-build-core)
background_removal: rembg u2net (Apache-2.0), separate process because rembg and torch load two OpenMP runtimes. rembg's new default bria-rmbg is non-commercial and was not used.
fixes_needed_on_macos: marching cubes volume moved to CPU (torchmcubes is CPU-only; TripoSR only falls back on AttributeError)
texture baker query points moved to the model device
output rotated to glTF Y-up like TripoSR's own demo
quality_assessment: Same geometry as the community Space (same model). Baked 2048 px texture is slightly sharper than vertex colours (swoosh, laces); not photo-real.
